name: saboreamexico
description: Responsive, mobile-first website exploring Mexican gastronomy through recipes, regional cuisine and dedicated pages on tacos and nachos. Built with HTML, Sass and JavaScript using ITCSS, BEM and OOCSS, with a strong focus on accessibility, responsive images and web performance optimization.

paragraphs: Saborea México is a responsive, multi-page website dedicated to Mexican gastronomy. It invites visitors to discover the country's culinary traditions through featured recipes, an overview of several Mexican regions, and in-depth pages on two iconic dishes: tacos and nachos, covering their history, ingredients, and preparation.

Beyond the content, the project is a hands-on exercise in modern front-end development: a mobile-first, accessible (W3C/WCAG) site built with Sass, PostHTML and Parcel, structured with ITCSS + BEM + OOCSS, and tuned for performance through image optimization, responsive images, lazy loading and PageSpeed Insights improvements.
features: Semantics and accessibility following W3C guidelines.
